topic: Electoral Integrity Dark Money Elimination and Campaign Transparency Bill

findings.title: Association for Democratic Reforms v. Union of India (2024) 5 SCC 1
findings.limitations: Unanimously struck down anonymous electoral bonds, holding that voter information on political party funding is a fundamental right under Article 19(1)(a).

gaps: Absence of real-time digital disclosure mandates for all corporate/individual political contributions and public campaign funding frameworks.
